extraction.name: MATH Dataset
extraction.description: A dataset of 12,500 challenging competition mathematics problems with step-by-step solutions.
extraction.creator: Dan Hendrycks, Collin Burns, Saurav Kadavath, Akul Arora, Steven Basart, Eric Tang, Dawn Song, Jacob Steinhardt
extraction.publisher: 35th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2021) Track on Datasets and Benchmarks
extraction.citeAs: Dan Hendrycks, Collin Burns, Saurav Kadavath, Akul Arora, Steven Basart, Eric Tang, Dawn Song, Jacob Steinhardt. Measuring Mathematical Problem Solving With the MATH Dataset. NeurIPS 2021.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Problems were collected from mathematics competitions including AMC 10, AMC 12, AIME, and more, sourced from aops.com/community/c3158_usa_contests.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Mathematics competition problems from AoPS (Art of Problem Solving) forums.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Problems and solutions were formatted using LaTeX and Asymptote. Final boxed answers were normalized for consistent formatting (e.g., fractions simplified, coefficients without multiplication symbol, variables in alphabetical order).
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Each problem has a step-by-step solution and a final boxed answer. Solutions were authored by competition problem creators and curated by the dataset authors.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Accuracy remains low even with large Transformer models; scaling alone is impractical for achieving strong performance.
